final: SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond_rate, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) - (SELECT AVG(album_rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS album_rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId)) AS difference_from_average_rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId ORDER BY difference_from_average_rate DESC LIMIT 10
